hebrewText: וְ/נָסַ֣ב לָ/כֶם֩ הַ/גְּב֨וּל מִ/נֶּ֜גֶב לְ/מַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְ/עָ֣בַר צִ֔נָ/ה ו/היה וְ/הָיוּ֙ תּֽוֹצְאֹתָ֔י/ו מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב לְ/קָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְ/יָצָ֥א חֲצַר אַדָּ֖ר וְ/עָבַ֥ר עַצְמֹֽנָ/ה

tokens.bdb: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
tokens.kjv: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

tokens.bdb: properly, a cord (as twisted), i.e. (by implication) a boundary; by extension the territory inclosed
tokens.kjv: border, bound, coast, [idiom] great, landmark, limit, quarter, space.

tokens.bdb: the south (from its drought); specifically, the Negeb or southern district of Judah, occasionally, Egypt (as south to Palestine)
Steep of Scorpions, a place in the Desert
tokens.kjv: Maaleh-accrabim, the ascent (going up) of Akrabbim.

tokens.bdb: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
tokens.kjv: alienate, alter, [idiom] at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) [phrase] proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, [phrase] raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, [phrase] shave, cause to (make) sound, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-) faring man, be wrath.
